title: Wavenum: local-first Raman, FTIR and XRD processing and mineral identification
description: Wavenum is an open-source application for Raman, FTIR and XRD spectra: a non-destructive processing pipeline, peak finding and fitting with Monte Carlo deconvolution, library-based mineral identification with cross-technique checks, PCA, spectral and element maps, a plot digitizer, and publication figure export.
